## Definition
A theoretical framework that computes upper bounds on output error given input noise magnitude, using Lipschitz constants or spectral norms of network layers. Offers a lightweight, hardware-friendly verification method for TCC/iNEST systems without exhaustive simulation, enabling fast design-space exploration.
